entries.name: Seed Audio 1.0
entries.description: All-in-one audio generation: dialogue, music, ambience, and sound effects in one pass, with voice cloning from up to 3 reference clips (under 30s each). The model field picks the variant: multilingual (default, 20 auto-detected languages, in-prompt timestamp control) or base (English/Chinese with the preset voice library).

params.label: Model
params.description: Model variant. Leave unset to infer: `seed-audio-1.0` when a preset `voice` is given, else `seed-audio-1.0-multilingual`. Set explicitly to override. `seed-audio-1.0-multilingual`: 20 languages auto-detected, voice via cloning references only. `seed-audio-1.0`: English/Chinese with the preset voice library (the `voice` field).

params.label: Enable Subtitles
params.description: Return per-sentence and per-word timestamps for the generated speech. When true, the completed job's audio output carries a `subtitle` asset — a JSON URL with {text, sentences[], words[]} (start_time/end_time in ms).

advanced.label: Voice
advanced.description: Preset speaker (base variant only — requires model=seed-audio-1.0; the multilingual variant's speaker map differs). Counts toward the 3 voice/audio reference cap.

entries.name: Topaz Image Upscale
entries.description: Upscale and enhance images with Topaz Labs models. One endpoint; the `model` request field picks the enhancement model (Standard V2 by default), priced per image up to 24MP output. The standard family keeps the original flat price; the generative family (redefine, standard-max, wonder, wonder-3, wonder-3.5) adds synthesized detail at a higher rate.

params.label: Upscale Factor
params.description: How much to enlarge the image: 2x, 3x, or 4x the original dimensions.

params.label: Model
params.description: Topaz enhancement model. Standard family (true-to-input upscaling): `standard-v2` (default, general purpose), `low-resolution-v2` (small/degraded sources), `cgi` (art and CGI), `high-fidelity-v2` (detail preservation), `text-refine` (text and shapes). Generative family (adds synthesized detail, priced higher): `redefine` (prompt-driven), `standard-max`, `wonder`, `wonder-3`, `wonder-3.5`.

params.label: Output Format
params.description: Output image format; omitted keeps the provider default (jpeg).

params.label: Crop To Fill
params.description: When the output aspect ratio differs, crop to fill the output dimensions instead of the default letterboxing.

params.label: Subject Detection
params.description: Where enhancements are applied; omitted lets Topaz auto-configure.

params.label: Face Enhancement
params.description: Apply Topaz's face recovery model. When true, `face_enhancement_strength` and `face_enhancement_creativity` are required. Omitted lets Topaz auto-configure.

params.label: Face Enhancement Strength
params.description: Face recovery strength (requires face_enhancement=true).

params.label: Face Enhancement Creativity
params.description: Realistic (0) to creative (1) face recovery (requires face_enhancement=true).

params.label: Sharpen
params.description: Sharpening strength.

params.label: Denoise
params.description: Denoise strength.

params.label: Fix Compression
params.description: Compression-artifact removal strength (standard models only).

params.label: Strength
params.description: Overall model strength (standard models only); too high can look unrealistic.

params.label: Autoprompt
params.description: Auto-generate the guidance prompt (generative models except wonder-3/wonder-3.5; replaces `prompt`).

params.label: Creativity
params.description: Generative creativity 1-9 (generative models only); lower stays truest to the input.

params.label: Texture
params.description: Generative texture detail 1-5 (generative models only); 1 at low creativity, 3 at higher.

params.label: Detail
params.description: Add post-render detail (generative models only). When true, `detail_strength` is required.

params.label: Detail Strength
params.description: Post-render detail strength (requires detail=true).

params.label: Enhancement Strength
params.description: Enhancement level (wonder-3 and wonder-3.5 only); omitted lets Topaz auto-configure.

entries.name: Topaz Video Upscale
entries.description: Upscale videos with Topaz Labs enhancement models. One endpoint; the `model` request field picks the enhancement model (Proteus by default), priced per second of output video by model.

params.label: Model
params.description: Topaz enhancement model. `proteus` (default) is the general-purpose upscaler; the `starlight-*` models are the slower, higher-quality diffusion family (sources up to 30fps, output up to 4K). Except `starlight-precise-2.6`, which scales exactly by upscale_factor, starlight output never drops below 720p — small sources come back larger than upscale_factor alone implies.

params.label: Compression
params.description: Compression-artifact recovery strength (proteus only).

params.label: Noise
params.description: Denoise strength (proteus only).

params.label: Halo
params.description: De-halo strength (proteus only).

params.label: Grain
params.description: Film grain to add (proteus only).

params.label: Recover Detail
params.description: How much original detail to preserve (proteus only).

params.label: H264 Output
params.description: Encode the output with H.264 instead of the default H.265.
